title: About Crenosoft | Human-Backed AI Agency Melbourne
desc: Crenosoft is a Melbourne-managed AI agency with an engineering team behind 150+ software and AI projects since 2022. Meet the human-backed AI agency.
h1: We Build AI That Works, and Stay to Make Sure It Does
lead: Crenosoft is a Melbourne-managed AI agency for Australian businesses. We design, build and run AI agents and automation, backed by an engineering and operations team that has delivered more than 150 software and AI projects since 2022.

body:
Our story

Crenosoft started as a software development company building custom software, web and mobile apps and automation systems for startups and growing businesses. As AI moved from experiments into everyday operations, our clients kept asking the same question: not “can you build an AI tool?”, but “who will make sure it keeps working?”

That question shaped the AI agency we are today. We still build, but we also run what we build. Our human-backed AI Employees service pairs custom AI with a dedicated team that checks the work, handles exceptions and improves the system every month.

What we do

  • AI consulting: strategy, readiness assessments, generative AI adoption and training
  • AI automation: business processes, workflows, CRM and document processing
  • AI agents: AI receptionists, voice agents, chatbots and custom task agents
  • AI development: custom AI apps, integrations, knowledge-base assistants and dedicated AI teams

How we are set up

Our Australian clients work with a team managed from Melbourne, with workshops in person across Greater Melbourne and remote delivery across Australia. Behind that sits an engineering and operations group in India that brings deep technical capacity and makes genuine round-the-clock coverage practical: when it is evening in Melbourne, it is the working day for part of our team.

We are open about this model because it is a strength. It means Australian businesses get senior engineering and 24/7 human review at a price that works for small and mid-sized companies, with local accountability for every project.

What we believe

Start with the problem, not the tool

Every engagement begins by understanding how work actually gets done. If a simple automation solves it, we say so. If AI won’t pay back, we say that too.

AI drafts, people decide

We design every system with clear handover points and human oversight, in line with Australian guidance. Read our Responsible AI Policy.

Measure everything

We record how long work takes before we build and report hours saved after. That is what makes our hours-saved guarantee possible.

Stay accountable

One team from audit to launch and beyond. No revolving door of freelancers, and no disappearing after go-live.

Who we work with

We work with Australian small and mid-sized businesses in healthcare, real estate, legal, accounting, trades, NDIS and aged care, education, eCommerce and professional services. Most have between 5 and 500 staff, a few busy systems and a team that is spending too much time on repetitive work.

Where we work

Our Australian team is managed from Melbourne. We meet clients in person across the CBD, inner and outer suburbs, Geelong and the Mornington Peninsula, and work remotely with businesses in Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide and beyond. See AI agency Melbourne.
